Daily Devotional

February 3

26 For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also. (James 2:26 KJV)

A person’s spirit is their soul, and when the soul departs from the body, the body dies, but the soul will never die, as it is a spiritual being. The definition of a man’s spirit is that it is his eternal soul. This verse is letting us know that faith without works is dead also. This seems to conflict with what Paul was teaching about you are saved by grace, not works (Ephesians 2:8-9). Of course it doesn’t conflict at all, because James is saying that if you have saving faith in Jesus, then you will have works of faith to show it. If you don’t ever have any works of faith, then you probably are not born again, as if you have the spirit of Jesus in you, it will lead you into doing works for Him out of your love for Him.

So many of our religious churches are still teaching that you must do certain things to be right with God, and they are referring to works of the law. If you have faith in Jesus and are born again, it will lead you to want to follow all the commands that Jesus gave us, as He said if we love Him, we will follow His commandments (John 14:15). So if you want to be assured that you are born again, then look at the fruit of what you do, as you will want to live for Jesus and do works for Him out of love, not to try to get anything from Him. Thank you Jesus for giving us your love in the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
